assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
The service directly addresses the diagnosis codes I25.10 and R42.
The service is required to clarify the cause of the patient's recurrent symptoms and guide appropriate cardiac management.
